local m_utils = require("Module:Utils")
local m_otd_json = mw.loadJsonData('Module:OT/old_tongue_dictionary.json')
local m = {}

function m._get_part(frame, args)
	return (m_otd_json[args.word] and m_otd_json[args.word].part) or nil
end

function m.get_part(frame)
	return m_utils.invoke_api(frame, m._get_part, "_get_part")
end

function m._get_definition(frame, args)
	return (m_otd_json[args.word] and m_otd_json[args.word].definition) or nil
end

function m.get_definition(frame)
	return m_utils.invoke_api(frame, m._get_definition, "_get_definition")
end

-- Useful test code:
-- print(p._get_entry(mw.getCurrentFrame(), { word="ajah" }))
function m._get_entry(frame, args)
	mw.log("Getting entry for "..args.word)
	if m_otd_json[args.word] then
		mw.log("Found entry for "..args.word)
		rendered = "<i>"..args.word.."</i> -"
		rendered = rendered..(m_otd_json[args.word].part and " ("..m_otd_json[args.word].part..")" or "")
		rendered = rendered..(m_otd_json[args.word].definition and " "..m_otd_json[args.word].definition or "")
		mw.log("Returning entry: "..rendered)
		return rendered
	end
	return nil
end

function m.get_entry(frame)
	return m_utils.invoke_api(frame, m._get_entry, "_get_entry")
end

return m
